runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_06b1b4b2cffeOLHdyo4Bw2D6SF] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
Here are the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet on June 20, 2026, queried from `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node`:

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| **Total slots with data** | 7200 (full day) |
| **Avg first-seen arrival** | ~1700 ms |
| **Min first-seen** | 215 ms (slot 14597916) |
| **Max first-seen** | 3725 ms (slot 14597760) |
| **Unique nodes per slot** | ~157 |

The query returned per-slot data for all ~7200 slots on June 20, 2026. Key columns: `slot`, `first_seen_ms` (earliest `seen_slot_start_diff`), `p50_ms`, `p95_ms`, `observations`, `unique_nodes`.

Full raw output is at `/tmp/panda-opencode-62_ck0tm/share/opencode/tool-output/tool_f94e50598001ie8y1rvd5AzyoT`.

[Turn 2 | session=ses_06b1b4b2cffeOLHdyo4Bw2D6SF] Plot the distribution of those arrival times as a chart.
Chart rendered and uploaded:

**URL:** http://127.0.0.1:2480/api/v1/storage/files/8128f98cdd7f/b7b226d8-5d21-42ee-8377-07e894c83728/arrival_distribution.png

**Distribution stats (7180 slots on 20 Jun 2026):**
| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Mean | 1710 ms |
| Median | 1453 ms |
| Min | 141 ms |
| Max | 5249 ms |
| p95 | 2997 ms |

The histogram shows a right-skewed distribution — most blocks are first seen within ~1–2 s of slot start, with a long tail extending to ~5.2 s.
